_readme: Fixture manifest. Adding a clip: run burnin.py over it, then
and add an entry here. The golden tests pick it up automatically.
`hand_labeled` is event truth read off the video BY A HUMAN, frame by frame. It is the
only thing that can satisfy doc 08 Phase 3's acceptance criterion (8 events within +-3
frames on >=80% of fixtures) — a golden snapshot proves the detector has not CHANGED,
never that it is RIGHT. Entries left null are skipped with a message rather than passing
vacuously. Do not fill these in from the detector's own output; that would make the
doc 08 Phase 0 wants >=10 fixtures spanning both views, both handedness, sim + range.
There are 2. Every acceptance percentage below N=10 is anecdote.

fixtures.notes: oblique/adult. Detector is weak here — contributes on 114/396 frames (29%). Address sits behind two decoy still-holds, which is what caught the D37 tempo bug.

DTL/junior. Detector strong — 298/341 frames (87%). Tempo legitimately reads 1.55:1; its Impact frame is independently confirmed by the club-head low point, so the D37 flag here is expected and is NOT a defect.
